citizenship_rules.normalization: Inspect actual CSV separators and normalize all listed citizenships without losing data.
citizenship_rules.legionnaire: citizenships is known/non-empty and does not include Ukraine
citizenship_rules.dual_ukrainian: not a legionnaire when Ukraine is one of multiple citizenships
citizenship_rules.country_specific: counts when target country appears anywhere in citizenships
citizenship_rules.primary_citizenship: for diversity achievements use the first normalized citizenship from source order
citizenship_rules.unknown: does not count as Ukrainian or legionnaire and must not create false positives

country_sets.africa: Use an explicit maintained set of sovereign African countries.

oleksandr_aliev.name: Oleksandr Aliev
oleksandr_aliev.citizenships: Must include Ukraine. Preserve any additional verified citizenships from existing source data; do not infer.
oleksandr_aliev.statistics: Use only values present in existing Patch 1.1 candidate/manual-review files. Never estimate; null is allowed.

bohdan_shust.name: Bohdan Shust
bohdan_shust.statistics: Use verified source values when available; otherwise leave missing statistics null. Never estimate.

achievements.condition: two attack slot team_ids identical; at least one win

achievements.description_ua: Пропустіть щонайменше 60 голів, але не потрапте в боротьбу за виживання.
achievements.description_en: Concede at least 60 league goals without a relegation-battle verdict.

achievements.title_ua: Кийов і Львов не указ Ужгородови
achievements.title_en: Kyiv and Lviv Don’t Rule Uzhorod
achievements.description_ua: Зберіть гравця ужгородського клубу без жодного представника Києва та Львова.
achievements.description_en: Field an Uzhhorod-club player with no Kyiv or Lviv club players.

achievements.description_ua: Зберіть щонайменше двох футболістів з албанським громадянством.
achievements.description_en: Field at least two players with Albanian citizenship.
